label: Face
description: One visible feature of a person's face: its shape, eyes, brows, nose, mouth, jaw, cheeks, forehead, ears or the marks and texture of the skin. Fits the person's drawn age.
notes: Every value of the person.feature lists, one piece at a time: one subtle piece reads as a face, while two or three named features stack and image models caricature them. Pieces rated strength 2 (marked) are drawn only when the user picks them. Never praise ('pretty', 'striking'): every piece says what is visible. A piece only one sex has is drawn only when the person's presentation says which (where={"presentation": ...}).
